resources.string: Agentle helps you understand your days from the data your phone already has, and can nudge you at the right moment with your own rules.
Your data stays on this phone
Everything Agentle collects is stored locally and encrypted. There is no Agentle cloud.
Agentle works fully without AI. You can connect ChatGPT later if you want.
Every data source asks separately, and you can turn each one off at any time in the Permission Center.
Data leaves the phone only when you choose to send selected context to AI.
Optional. You can connect or change these at any time.
App usage, activity, battery and other signals from Android.
Steps, sleep and heart rate from your watch or tracker. Connect it later in Data Sources.
Optional AI insights with your ChatGPT account. Connect it later.
Agentle shows your nudges as notifications. Without them, nudges wait as cards in the app.
Lets Agentle notice when you walk, run, cycle or sit still, so rules can react to movement. Nothing leaves the phone.
Not allowed. Agentle works without it; you can change this later.
Android will not ask again. You can allow it in Android Settings.
This is what Agentle can use now. Change anything later in the Permission Center.
